title: Heavy Words, Light Talk
text:
Formal registers are often praised for their precision, yet they can also create distance between a speaker and an audience. A sentence such as 'I am afraid we must decline your proposal' sounds courteous, but it conceals a judgement that a blunter speaker would state plainly. Colloquial speech, by contrast, tends to close that distance, though it risks sounding careless when used in the wrong setting.

Skilled communicators therefore move between registers as the situation demands. A lawyer addressing a court relies on elaborate phrasing, whereas the same lawyer may speak in short, direct sentences to a frightened client. The most persuasive speakers rarely choose one register and keep it. Instead, they treat the spectrum from formal to casual as a set of tools, each suited to a particular purpose.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what can formal registers create between a speaker and an audience?
According to the second paragraph, how does the lawyer speak to a frightened client?
Why does the author describe the sentence 'I am afraid we must decline your proposal' as concealing a judgement?
options: Because its polite wording hides a refusal that a blunter speaker would state directly
Because it is written in a language the listener does not understand
Because it contains a hidden threat to the listener
Because it is too short to express any opinion

questions.text: What can be inferred about the most persuasive speakers, according to the passage?
options: They use one register consistently in every situation
They treat registers as tools chosen for a specific purpose
They prefer colloquial speech because it is always more accurate

paragraph_translations: Resmî dil kullanımları çoğu zaman kesinliği nedeniyle övülür; ancak konuşmacı ile dinleyici arasında mesafe de yaratabilirler. 'I am afraid we must decline your proposal' gibi bir cümle nazik görünür, ama daha açık sözlü bir konuşmacının düz bir şekilde söyleyeceği bir yargıyı gizler. Buna karşılık gündelik konuşma bu mesafeyi kapatma eğilimindedir, fakat yanlış bir ortamda kullanıldığında özensiz görünme riski taşır.

Becerikli iletişimciler, durumun gerektirdiği şekilde kayıtlar arasında geçiş yapar. Bir mahkemeye hitap eden avukat ayrıntılı bir ifade kullanırken, aynı avukat korkmuş bir müvekkile kısa ve doğrudan cümlelerle konuşabilir. En ikna edici konuşmacılar nadiren tek bir kaydı seçip ona bağlı kalır. Bunun yerine resmîden samimiye uzanan yelpazeyi, her biri belirli bir amaca uygun birer araç olarak değerlendirirler.
